parameters.content:
## Groww Review Pulse (free stack)
Play Store reviews → themes → weekly pulse + fee explainer → **human approval** → Google Doc entry + Gmail draft.

Runs on **self-hosted n8n (free)**. No Apify, no paid LLM.
**Setup:** fill in **Config**; add credentials on *Free LLM* (Gemini free key, or any text for Ollama), both Gmail nodes and Google Docs.

### Step 1 · Review intelligence
Upload a CSV (form), or every Monday fetch the last 12 weeks straight from Google Play (free). Max 5 themes, top 3 by 1–2★ volume, 3 real quotes, the most-confused fee.

### Step 2–3 · Pulse + fee explainer
A free LLM (Gemini free tier, or Ollama on your computer) may tighten the pulse. A validator keeps its draft only if it is ≤250 words, keeps the 3 quotes verbatim, keeps every number and has 3 actions; otherwise the data-driven template is used. Fee facts come only from the verified knowledge base.

### Step 4 · APPROVAL GATE
The workflow **pauses** here and emails the approver the full pulse and explainer with **Approve / Reject** buttons. Nothing is written to the doc or Gmail until someone clicks Approve. Times out after 3 days → nothing written.

### Step 5 · Actions after approval
1. Append {date, top_themes, weekly_pulse, identified_fee_issue, explanation_bullets, source_links} to the Google Doc.
2. Create a Gmail **draft** (no recipients; never sent).

parameters.formDescription: Upload a Play Store reviews CSV (columns: date, rating, text; review_id and helpful_count optional). The pulse and fee explainer are emailed to the approver before anything is logged or drafted.

values.formSubmittedText: Got it. The pulse is being generated; the approver will get an email to approve or reject.
